jtbd.text: When building multi-step plans in code generation and arithmetic reasoning, users want to ensure that generated actions strictly satisfy symbolic constraints, so that they can avoid infeasible actions and hallucinations.

value_prop.text: By integrating intent-constraint representations into search algorithms, the framework actively focuses exploration toward semantically valid actions, outperforming baselines in accuracy and structural alignment.

riskiest_assumption.text: The riskiest assumption is on axis V (viability), designated explicitly due to missing evidence in the evidence bundle.

mvp.text: Conduct customer interviews and a price acceptance test with a proposed threshold of 30 percent willingness to pay to test whether potential users find the constraint-guided code generation and arithmetic reasoning solution economically viable.

success_metric.text: Achieve a proposed threshold of 70 percent positive feedback on economic value and pricing during customer interviews.

kill_criteria.text: Fewer than a proposed threshold of 20 percent of interviewed customers indicate a willingness to pay for the proposed solution.
